title: A return already filed, transcribed line by line - data
description: Not a computation. This is what a filed ITR-V, acknowledgement, filed JSON or the utility's own PDF actually says, copied across without correction, so the tool's figures can be set beside it and every difference named.

identity.description: Enough to be sure this document is the return for this person and this year.

form.description: ITR-1, ITR-2, ITR-3 and so on, as printed.

filed_on.description: ISO date the return was filed, if the document states it.

filing_section.description: Section it was filed under, e.g. '139(1)', '139(4)', '139(5)' for a revised return.

revised.description: True where the document says it is a revised or updated return, which matters because an earlier filing then no longer stands.

part_b_ti.description: Every line of Part B-TI the document prints, in the order it prints them, including lines that are nil. A line left out cannot be compared, and a missing line is indistinguishable from an agreed one.

item.description: The line number exactly as the document prints it: '1', '3i', '4ai', '12c'. This is what the comparison matches on, so it is copied character for character and never tidied, renumbered or guessed at.

label.description: The line's wording as printed, abbreviated only if it runs past a line break in the source.

part_b_tti.description: Every line of Part B-TTI the document prints, on the same terms. This is the part the tool compares against, so completeness here matters most.

item.description: The line number exactly as printed: '1a', '2a', '2giv', '8e', '10e'. Copied character for character.

schedules.description: Optional. Totals of other schedules the document prints - Schedule S item 6, Schedule BP item A37, Schedule OS item 6, Schedule TR - so a difference in the tax can be traced to the schedule it came from.
